limits: Includes operator/test accounts if their locale is ka; no PII fetched or manual account exclusion.
Activity rows indicate an authenticated visit, not a value action or session count.
date_local is the user profile timezone; dashboard-style Tbilisi cutoffs are used.
Generated/saved content is not proof of reading.
Cumulative return 24h-8d is not exact-day D7 retention.
DAU/MAU here uses last 7 completed day average divided by rolling 30d MAU; not today partial DAU.
Cohort sample is last 42 days with per-window matured denominators.
Credit issuance/spend is wallet accounting, not cash revenue or model compute cost.
